summary: Phase 1 (design gate) of plan 04 COMPLETE with GO verdict. Recorded the Garg-Genovese-Negri Sfor-containment loop-check design as a docstring + trivial none-returning stub `intFImpReuseWitness?` in Expansion.lean. The check is fully expressible against existing IBranch/IEdges/posFormulasAt/isAccessible primitives using values already in go's own scope (bPers, edges, newForms, newEdge) -- no new persistent field, no new structure, and NO signature change to intFImpRule/intApplyRuleFull/intStepBranch is required. edges is available one level up (in go, the intExpandBranches inner loop) from where the F(phi->psi) world-creating rule fires, exactly where the reuse decision must be made. Sfor(w') and the obligation psi are read directly off the already-computed newForms (no recomputation needed). Phase 2 (implement + wire into go) is next; not started. No sorry closed or created this phase (design-only, per plan). GargGenoveseNegri2012 BibKey cited in the docstring but not yet added to references.bib -- that is explicitly Phase 6 of this same plan, not a blocker for Phase 1 or 2. This supersedes the plan-03 R1-measure blocker recorded below (that blocker was against the abandoned decreasing-measure approach; this plan (04) uses the Sfor-containment approach instead and its own R1 gate is GO).

design_verdict.final_design: Fires inside go's existing `some (.linearResult newForms nw' (some newEdge), newExp)` branch, BEFORE Branch.extendMany/edge append. Which set: Sfor(w') = {phi} union posFormulasAt bPers w, read as the sign=.pos sublist of newForms (intFImpRule already builds newForms = [T(phi)@w', F(psi)@w'] ++ propagatePersistence b w w'). Obligation psi is the sign=.neg entry of newForms. Source world w = newEdge.2 (intFImpRule returns edge (w', w)). Reuse condition: some x with isAccessible edges w x AND Sfor(w') subseteq posFormulasAt bPers x AND psi not in posFormulasAt bPers x -> do not create w', mark F(phi->psi)@w expanded, continue same branch (call intExpandBranches with bPers unchanged and edges unchanged, not extended). Else create w' as today.
design_verdict.signature_change_reasoning: go already has bPers and edges (pre-extension) in its own parameter scope at the exact point the check must run. intFImpRule/intApplyRuleFull/intStepBranch keep their current parameter lists (phi psi w nextWorld b / sf nextWorld b / b expanded nextWorld). No new parameter is threaded through the rule layer at all -- the check is implemented entirely as logic living in/near go, consuming newForms and newEdge that intStepBranch already returns.
